north_star: A soft illustrated archive of Aachu and Zuv's love, chaos, culture, and tiny rituals.
shared_style_prompt: Premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink illustration on warm ivory paper grain; fine ink and pencil linework, transparent watercolor blooms, muted vintage palette, tactile clothing, soft faded edges, exact integrated upper text, and tiny top-right @a.storyof.two.
compact_style_prompt: Premium hand-drawn romantic watercolor-and-ink illustration on warm ivory paper grain; fine ink and pencil linework, transparent watercolor blooms, muted vintage palette, tactile clothing, soft faded edges, exact integrated upper text, and tiny top-right @a.storyof.two.
shared_negative_prompt: No photorealism, 3D, glossy AI stock finish, flat vector art, anime, doll faces, generic couple faces, yellow or mustard cast, quote-card layout, UI, split screen, extra people, duplicate couple, extra limbs, malformed hands, broken contact, dense clutter, random text, missing or misspelled copy, missing brandmark, or unrequested logos.

typography.placement: Exact approved text in generous clean upper-middle paper space without covering faces, hands, props, or gestures.

visual_cues: expressive dark eyes and long dark wavy hair
warm medium-brown South Asian skin tone
aachu.signature_accessory: Evil-eye bracelet on her right wrist whenever the right wrist or forearm is visible.

visual_cues: curly dark hair, strong brows, defined nose, and short natural stubble
warm medium-brown South Asian skin tone
zuv.signature_accessory: Small round evil-eye locket centered on a slim silver chain whenever the neck, open collar, or upper chest is visible.

identity_reference_policy.rule: Use a small story-specific bundle of actual Aachu/Zuv files on every generation call; text descriptions and filenames alone are not identity evidence.
hard_fail_if: No actual identity image is attached.
The entire identity library is attached.
Identity appears only in metadata rather than the image input.
A generated person is generic or not recognizably based on the selected bundle.

visual_story_policy.rule: After copy and format lock, each slide states one observable physical event; prove the riskiest event in actual pixels before generating the rest.
pixel_review_order: people, entities, anatomy, contact, and spatial depth
exact text, brandmark, house style, and dimensions
hard_fail_if: The physical event cannot be identified with copy hidden.
The image creates a competing relationship or task read.
Adjacent slides repeat the same pose, action, angle, and story job.
A failed semantic proof is promoted or reported as handoff-ready.

production_gate.rule: Only requested native, text-bearing illustrations can become final. Identity photos control likeness and wardrobe; style references control watercolor-and-ink finish. Exact text, top-right brandmark, physical action, entity/anatomy/spatial integrity, identity, style, and dimensions must pass on current pixels.
production_gate.approved_creation_path: scripts/create_illustration_carousel.py using the four-gate compact package contract
